packageJson.description: Structural expectations for every package manifest so validators can provide actionable hints.
packageJson.magicStringError: Avoid sprinkling inline command strings—reuse the constants defined above.

build.message: Build scripts must delegate to workspace helpers (e.g., `pnpm run build:ts`).

build:ts.description: Every module exposes the direct TypeScript builder so pnpm can orchestrate dependencies.

test.message: Use `pnpm run test:unit` (or another approved helper) instead of invoking `vite` directly.

test:unit.hint: Keep the per-package unit script tied to workspace helpers so filters stay stable.

rules.name: typescript
rules.message: TypeScript belongs at the workspace root; remove it from package devDependencies.

rules.name: vitest
rules.message: Vitest lives only at the root; the package-level config should rely on the shared `vitest.config.ts`.
Internal dependencies must use `workspace:*` so pnpm keeps versions aligned.

references.message: Remove direct `references` entries; rely on the workspace project references instead of local ones.

tsconfig.description: Production compiler settings (DOM/Node) must extend the shared base and remain strict.

tsconfig.test.description: Test-specific compiler settings must extend the shared base but loosen outputs.

vitestConfig.description: Every module should keep the shared Vitest 4 configuration accessible at root/vitest.config.ts.
